steps.prompt: In {cwd}, build the SQL engine README.md specifies, in src/ (export createDatabase from src/index.js as the visible tests import it), with thorough tests in tests/. Node 22 standard library only. Keep npm test passing.

areas: NULL logic, aggregates, GROUP BY and HAVING
UPDATE/DELETE, errors, LIKE, IN and BETWEEN
steps.prompt: In {cwd}, review the code in src/ and its tests against README.md, which is the contract. Write and run small scripts against createDatabase to confirm each finding. Any behaviour that differs from README.md is a finding, even if it looks intended. Each finding: inScope true when it is a difference from README.md, a one-line title naming what is wrong and where, a severity, and a detail with a concrete input and the wrong versus expected result. Change no file.
In {cwd}, fix every finding you are given so the engine matches README.md, each with a regression test in tests/. Keep npm test passing.
